title: Medical Vault Subject, version 1
description: A person whose records are held in this vault. Deliberately minimal: the vault stores results, not a clinical chart.

names_raw.description: Every spelling this person appears under across reports — Latin, Chinese characters, transliterations. Used to check that an uploaded document belongs to the subject it was filed under.

birth_date.description: Enables age-at-test, which some reference ranges depend on.

sex_at_birth.description: Recorded only because many laboratory reference ranges are stratified by it.
